name: Yarelle Pike
role: Watch captain keeping the gates; the first-named of Halda's six captains
appearance: Tall and weathered, a gate-keeper's squint, her gorget dulled by years on the wall.
voice: Dry and measured; counts posts and shifts aloud and says 'by the roster' when she is sure.
backstory: The first-named of Halda's six captains and the one Halda leans on for the gates. She stood in the half-ring at the noon hearing on day 3 when the captains ruled the Coal had not chosen Kitwin, and voted with Halda on day 9 to open the gates on Halda's terms. She is quiet about Rook: her postern roster took his two men without a question.
wants: A clean roster and the gates kept honestly under whichever council sits.
fears: Another traitor on her own rolls; the gates forced from inside.

relationships.how: her Watch-Captain, whom she has followed for years
fellow captain whose recommended men she let onto the postern roster
a hired sword who has done Watch work at her gates

secrets: You signed Rook's two recommended men onto the postern roster after the roc and never asked who vouched for them. You blame yourself.
dm_only: Only her name, her rank and her place at the noon hearing are canon. Invented by npc-creator: that she keeps the gates, her age, appearance, voice, alignment, the Knight stat block and the roster guilt.
The day-9 vote was four captains to one; she is among the four.
